rows.en: (Phew, the tests are finally over...)

Hey, \p!
What's with that face?

Oh, Gary-sensei.
The tests are finally over, so I'm kind of
running on empty...
rows.notes: Male scene. ki ga nukeru: the tension has gone out of him.

rows.en:
I see. Students sure have it rough.
Then for the next P.E. class, let's take a
breather and hold a joint swim meet with the girls!
...Hilda-sensei's going to chew you out again...
rows.notes: Male scene. 'again' as in the Japanese.

rows.en: ...Well... I guess you've got a point...

(Gary-sensei never stands a chance against
Hilda-sensei...)
(Whew, the tests are finally done...)

Oh, Gary-sensei.
The tests are finally over, so I'm kind of
zoned out...

I see. Students sure have it rough.
Then for the next P.E. class, let's take a
breather and hold a joint swim meet with the boys!

Isn't that just something YOU want, Sensei...?
Hilda-sensei's going to chew you out again...

(Gary-sensei really never stands a chance
against Hilda-sensei...)

(Lunchtime, huh. I wonder what's in
my lunch today...)
(Th... This is... Don't tell me, in my lunch...)

Oh, \p.
What, a packed lunch? Geez, aren't you
living the good life!
Oh, Gary-sensei.

Lemme just have a little taste...
Hm!? What's that smell...?
Um, well, that's my lunch for today...
Th... That sticky stuff... Is that...?

Oh, yes, it's Starlight Natto...
Want some?
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Product name sutaraito natto, not in the glossary: 'Starlight Natto'.

rows.en:
No, uh, well, y'see...
My stomach's acting up today, so I'll pass...
See ya!
Ah! Sensei!
(So Sensei can't stand Starlight Natto...)
(Lunchtime! I wonder what my lunch is today...)

(Huh!? Th... This is...
Don't tell me, in my lunch...)
(So Sensei can't stand Starlight Natto...)

(Whoa~ I've gotta hurry to the
Practical Training building!)
rows.notes: Shared male/female. jitsugi kunren-tou: the building for Practical Training classes.

rows.en: Whoa there!
rows.notes: x5: also the player in nml_kln_007 and Michel in nml_mcl_007; kept generic.

rows.en: S-sorry, Gary-sensei.

Geez, where are you rushing off to?
If you got hurt, it'd be a real disaster!

I'm really sorry.
My next class is Practical Training,
so I've gotta hurry...

I see. But listen, being late for class versus...
Hm!? Next class... Practical Training?
That's MY class?

Gah, I completely forgot...
See ya, I'm going on ahead!
Sensei... It's dangerous to rush like that...
(Sensei sure doesn't practice what he preaches...)

I'm really sorry.
My next class is Practical Training,
so I thought I'd better hurry...
Sensei... Rushing like that is dangerous...
(Sensei never practices what he preaches...)
(Lunch break, huh. Now, what should I eat...)

(Huh, it's Gary-sensei...
Looks like he's eating something.
Is he having lunch?)
rows.notes: x3: player monologue (male); in both variants it also sits under Gary's name plate after c16292 (likely a script slip). Kept as the player's monologue, gender-neutral.

rows.en: Gary-sensei, are you having lunch out here?

Hey, \p.
Wanna eat with me?

Sure, why not... Wait...
What is that you're eating?

A bagel sandwich with chicken breast
and egg whites...
rows.notes: Shared male/female. sasami: lean chicken breast.

rows.en: Th... That sounds like it'd taste of nothing...

You think? It's more edible than you'd expect.
And it's no trouble to make. Here, want some?
No, I'll pass...
Alright. If you ever want some, come by anytime!

(Is Gary-sensei watching his health
or something...?)
(Lunch break! Now, what should I eat...)

(Oh, Gary-sensei...
Looks like he's eating something.
Having lunch, maybe?)

Hmm, sure... Wait...
What is that you're eating?
Th... That sounds kinda... bland...
Um... I'll pass...

(Is Gary-sensei watching his health
or something, I wonder...)
(Okay, that's it for today's EX-Gear training.)
\p, hold it!
Gary-sensei? Is something wrong?

Listen, were you paying proper attention
in class just now?

Yes, of course!
In this class, if you slack off, you won't just
get hurt. It could cost you your life!

I see... Then let me ask you...
About two minutes ago, a woman walked past
the main gate. Which way did she go?
Huh!? What?

Just answer the question!
You should've been able to see from the sky!

Well, I guess I'd have seen her
if I'd been watching for her...

Dammit! I should've ditched class and
gone after her! You're useless too!
Sensei, that has nothing to do with class...
(Where is Gary-sensei even looking during class...?)
(Okay, that wraps up today's EX-Gear training.)
Yes? Gary-sensei? Is something wrong?

Yes, of course!
In this class, slack off and you won't just get hurt.
It could cost you your life, after all!

Well, I suppose I'd have seen her
if I'd been watching for her...

Sensei, that has absolutely nothing
to do with class...
(Just where is Gary-sensei looking during class...?)
